title: Contact form shows a successful submission as an error
evidence: app/(public)/contato/ContactForm.tsx (base e673bf9): event.currentTarget.reset() after await fetch
Playwright on base build: 201 response, visitor sees alert "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'reset')"
Playwright on base build with 502 HTML: alert "Unexpected token '<' ... is not valid JSON"
rootCause: React nulls SyntheticEvent.currentTarget after the handler yields; reset() threw TypeError inside try, so the catch rendered the JS error as the result and the idempotency key was never rotated. response.json() on non-JSON error pages surfaced parser errors.
invariantViolated: The UI must report the true outcome of a persisted submission
blastRadius: every successful contact submission since the form shipped; duplicates on user retry were deduped server-side only while the key stayed the same

autofix.reason: deterministic client bug with reproducible browser test

correction: capture formElement before await; parse error bodies defensively; readable network error; post to /api/contact/
regressionRisk: low — client-only change, server contract unchanged

history.note: browser trace of the contact journey
root cause traceable in repo; autofix eligible
